gloss: sense of relief; feeling of reassurance

definitions.gloss: sense of relief; feeling of reassurance
definitions.explanation: The emotional feeling of relief when anxiety or worry is resolved. Describes the specific sensation of tension lifting.

examples.japanese: {安堵感|あんどかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{包|つつ}まれた→包む：01226_tsutsumu⟧。
examples.english: I was enveloped in a sense of relief.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合格|ごうかく}して→合格する：27949_goukakusuru⟧{安堵感|あんどかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}えた→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧。
examples.english: I felt a sense of relief after passing the exam.

examples.japanese: ⟦{無事|ぶじ}→無事：01602_buji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{終|お}わった→終わる：00567_owaru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧、⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{安堵感|あんどかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がった→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: When I heard the surgery had ended safely, a great sense of relief spread through me.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{安堵|あんど}→安堵：05818_ando⟧ (relief) + ⟦{感|かん}→〜感：28578_kan⟧ (feeling, sense). While ⟦{安堵|あんど}→安堵：05818_ando⟧ by itself means relief, adding ⟦{感|かん}→〜感：28578_kan⟧ emphasizes the subjective, felt experience of that relief.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {安堵感|あんどかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}える→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧: to feel a sense of relief
- {安堵感|あんどかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{包|つつ}まれる→包む：01226_tsutsumu⟧: to be wrapped in relief
- {安堵感|あんどかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がる→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧: a sense of relief spreads
- ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{安堵感|あんどかん}: great relief

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{安心|あんしん}→安心：01288_anshin⟧: peace of mind (broader; can be a state rather than a moment)
- ⟦{安堵|あんど}→安堵：05818_ando⟧: relief (the emotion itself, without the ⟦{感|かん}→〜感：28578_kan⟧ suffix)
- ⟦ほっとする→ほっとする：07652_hottosuru⟧: to feel relieved (colloquial, onomatopoeic expression)
